trials.claim: Download, convert and save videos, audio, playlists and subtitles from 1,000+ sites in any format
trials.claimQuote: Download, convert, and save videos, audio, playlists, and subtitles from 1,000+ sites in any format
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports it works for YouTube but does nothing on other sites, and the binding terms prohibit downloading copyrighted material without permission, materially limiting the 1,000+ sites in any format claim.

exhibits.quote: Downloading copyrighted material without the permission of the copyright owner is strictly prohibited.
exhibits.argument: The terms prohibit downloading copyrighted material without permission, which limits the claim of downloading from any site in any format.

exhibits.quote: Good for YouTube, does nothing on other sites. Extension does not work.. UPDATE:
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports the tool works only for YouTube and nothing on other sites, contradicting 1,000+ sites coverage.

exhibits.quote: Effortlessly download videos, audio, thumbnails, and subtitles from over 1,000 sites, including YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and X.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states it downloads videos, audio and subtitles from over 1,000 sites.

exhibits.quote: Being able to grab videos, extract audio, and download subtitles without any hassle has made my workflow so much smoother.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms grabbing videos, extracting audio and downloading subtitles works without hassle.

trials.claim: Download videos, audio and subtitles from 1,000+ sites in up to 8K quality
trials.claimQuote: SurFast lets you download videos, audio, and subtitles from 1,000+ sites in up to 8K quality.
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report being unable to download anything or downloads always getting stuck and never completing, directly conflicting with promised downloads up to 8K.

exhibits.quote: I am unable to download anything (last 2 months or so), whether from YouTube or elsewhere.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports being unable to download anything at all, undermining the promise of downloads in up to 8K quality.

exhibits.quote: Could not download singel video because it always gets stuck at xy% and does not resume.
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports videos never complete downloading, so the promised high-quality downloads are not delivered.

exhibits.quote: It supports downloading videos in any resolution from 128p up to stunning 8K quality.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states downloads are supported up to 8K quality.

exhibits.quote: Enjoy ultra-high resolutions like 8K, 4K, and 1080p, with flexible formats such as MP4, MP3, GIF, and more.
exhibits.argument: Vendor advertises ultra-high resolutions like 8K with flexible formats.

trials.claim: Supports 10+ formats, batch and clip downloads, plus auto-tracking for channels/playlists
trials.claimQuote: Support 10+ formats, batch & clip downloads, plus auto-tracking for channels/playlists — all in one simple tool
trials.reasoning: Buyers report trimming/clipping is faulty with videos cut off and tracking is only interval-based at a daily specific time, materially limiting the claimed clip downloads and auto-tracking.

exhibits.quote: Some functionalities did not work ok. for eg. trimming videos : faulty, as videos got cut off
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports trimming/clipping is faulty with videos cut off, contradicting reliable clip downloads.

exhibits.quote: "Tracking" is interval based (>= Daily at specific time).
exhibits.argument: The buyer reports tracking is only interval-based daily, undermining the claim of automatic channel/playlist tracking.

exhibits.quote: You can effortlessly download entire YouTube playlists/channels or save all videos from a TikTok profile with just one link.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states bulk playlist and channel downloads work with one link.

exhibits.quote: For playlists, channels, or YouTubers, the tool checks for updates at your preferred frequency and downloads new videos automatically.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states auto-tracking checks for updates and downloads new videos automatically.
